import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,sys,tarfile,time,urllib.request
from datetime import datetime,timezone
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); evidence=root/"docs/operations/evidence/issue-93/child-c/raw/setup"
target=pathlib.Path("/workspace/.tools/issue-103-dotnet-10.0.402")
started=time.monotonic()
receipt={"command":["timeout","--kill-after=5s","600s",*sys.orig_argv],"source_commit":subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],cwd=root,text=True).strip(),"wall_time_cap_seconds":600,"started_utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"status":"started"}
code=1
try:
    candidates=[shutil.which("dotnet"),"/usr/share/dotnet/dotnet",str(target/"dotnet"),"/workspace/.tools/issue-100-dotnet-10.0.402/dotnet"]
    selected=None
    for candidate in candidates:
        if candidate and pathlib.Path(candidate).is_file():
            result=subprocess.run([candidate,"--version"],cwd=root,text=True,capture_output=True)
            if result.returncode==0 and result.stdout.strip()=="10.0.402":
                selected=candidate; break
    if selected is None:
        url="https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/Sdk/10.0.402/dotnet-sdk-10.0.402-linux-x64.tar.gz"
        expected="1904a98dda2db34ba78ba3c4fb1b224455329af91c341d83547843c1839e112b04ae699ee92fa2449a8f62249196a938723078c0c60b9f65c88539d5687729c2"
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        archive=target.parent/"issue-103-dotnet-sdk.tar.gz"
        assert not archive.exists() and not target.exists()
        digest=hashlib.sha512(); size=0
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=90) as response, archive.open("xb") as output:
            while block:=response.read(1024*1024):
                output.write(block); digest.update(block); size+=len(block)
        receipt["archive"]={"url":url,"size_bytes":size,"sha512":digest.hexdigest(),"expected_sha512":expected}
        assert digest.hexdigest()==expected,"SDK archive SHA-512 mismatch"
        target.mkdir()
        with tarfile.open(archive) as source: source.extractall(target,filter="data")
        selected=str(target/"dotnet")
    receipt["selected_dotnet"]=selected
    environment=os.environ.copy(); environment["DOTNET_ROOT"]=str(pathlib.Path(selected).parent)
    for name,args in [("sdk-version.txt",["--version"]),("dotnet-info.txt",["--info"]),("runtimes.txt",["--list-runtimes"]),("nuget-sources.txt",["nuget","list","source"])]:
        result=subprocess.run([selected,*args],cwd=root,env=environment,text=True,capture_output=True)
        (evidence/name).write_text(result.stdout+result.stderr)
        assert result.returncode==0,f"{args} failed"
        if name=="sdk-version.txt": assert result.stdout.strip()=="10.0.402"
    receipt["status"]="passed"; code=0
except Exception as error:
    receipt["status"]="failed"; receipt["error"]=type(error).__name__+": "+str(error)
finally:
    receipt["elapsed_seconds"]=time.monotonic()-started; receipt["exit_code"]=code
    receipt["finished_utc"]=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    with (evidence/"setup.json").open("x") as output: json.dump(receipt,output,indent=2); output.write("\n")
print(json.dumps({"status":receipt["status"],"elapsed_seconds":receipt["elapsed_seconds"],"selected_dotnet":receipt.get("selected_dotnet"),"error":receipt.get("error")}))
sys.exit(code)
